title: fix(runtime): an action body that runs out of time answers a sentence naming the action and its limit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziunkXbDT7wUWqfmWz

Fixes #35027

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作脚本超时（CPU 时限，或等待平台调用超过墙钟上限）时，REST `/actions` 与 MCP `run_action` 仍回答 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`，但消息从光秃秃的 "Internal server error" 变成点名动作和时限的一句话，例如 `Action 'X' timed out: it exceeded its 50 ms time limit and was stopped.`
- 为什么改：按裁决 C（「35027 C」，记录 6965765884）。调用方（尤其 MCP 里的 AI）以前分不清"这个动作慢"和"平台坏了"。状态码与错误码不变，只换句子；句子只含动作名和毫秒数，不含任何数据。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `budgetError` 的动作分支；钩子、定时任务的超时完全不变（无 `innerMessage`、无 `status`），崩溃仍是消毒后的 500。句子声明为 500，所以 `/data` 门不会把它当业务原文转出。第 3 轮修了合同审查的 F1：声明了 `refusals` 的动作以前会把这句话（以及编译失败那句）当成"没带 code 的抛出"改写成裸 500，日志也记错原因；现在运行器按身份标记自己的故障，拒绝目录直接放行。动作自己抛的无 code 错误（哪怕带 500、哪怕抄了超时原文）仍按未声明拒绝。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`（`resolveSandboxedRefusal` 第一行的 `isRunnerOwnFault` 放行）；`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`（`budgetError` 的两个 `action` 分支、`actionTimeoutSentence` 与 `runnerOwnFaults`）；`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`（末尾新 describe 的四个钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/sandbox/sandboxed-action-crash-is-a-fault.test.ts src/sandbox/action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`，预期 31 条全过，其中声明了 `refusals` 的动作超时，在 HTTP 门与 MCP 读取器上同样给出那句话，日志保留 CPU 时限那一行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/runtime`, `quickjs-runner.ts`.** `budgetError` gains an `action` arm on each of its two limits. For an action, the `SandboxError` keeps its operator line in `.message` (`action 'NAME' exceeded CPU budget of Nms (after P pump iterations)`, unchanged), and now carries `innerMessage` = `actionTimeoutSentence(...)` and a declared `status: 500`, with no `code`. This is the shape of the compile-failure precedent (`actionBodyCompileFailure`, merged in 743308b90c). The two sentences:
  - CPU budget: `Action 'NAME' timed out: it exceeded its N ms time limit and was stopped.`
  - Wall-clock ceiling: `Action 'NAME' timed out: it exceeded its N ms time limit while waiting on platform calls, and was stopped.`
- **What answers it.** `actionsDoorAnswerOf` (`@objectstack/types`, not edited) reads the sentence through `sandboxBusinessMessage`. Arm 2 (crash) does not take it, because the sentence is not native-error-named. Arm 3 serves the declared status, with the status's own `INTERNAL_ERROR` and the sentence (`looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` reads false). The HTTP door (`HttpDispatcher.handleActions`) and MCP `run_action` / `resume_run` (`errorResultFromThrown`) both render that one reader, so they give the same sentence.
- **Ruling conditions, as measured:**
  1. Only a timeout gains a sentence. Status and code stay `500` / `INTERNAL_ERROR`. A crash keeps `Internal server error`: the crash path is untouched, and a pin holds it on both doors.
  2. Actions only. Hook and job timeouts keep the 1-argument `SandboxError` with no `innerMessage` and no `status`. On `/data`, `mapDataError` relays a sandbox `innerMessage` only below the server band, so the declared `500` keeps the action sentence off that door too. A pin measures this. `sandbox-business-message.ts` needed no edit.
  3. Both doors give the same sentence, and `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` gains a "Sandboxed body timed out" row under Action Errors. "sandbox timeout" moves out of the crash row.
- **Core sandbox-fault census** (`packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts`, not edited). Each new construction keeps a literal template as its message, using interpolations the census already samples (`args.origin.name`, `cpuBudget`, `wallCeiling`, `pumps`). The census picks the new sites up (`quickjs-runner.ts:250` and `:262` in its §2) with no new sample, and still finds the hook/job fault sites its `CPU budget` / `wall-clock ceiling` floors need. 48/48 green.
- **Tests.** Two existing pins asserted the old action-timeout shape, so they now assert the sentence. `unreadable-rejection-recorded.test.ts`: the never-settles control expected `innerMessage` undefined. `sandbox-unreadable-rejection-door.test.ts`: a real-stack `/actions` door case now also asserts the message. That file also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited door test.
- **Docs made consistent (round 2, L1 S1 / N1).** `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`: the 500 bullet now reads "it **crashed** (a `TypeError` in your handler, a driver error) or **timed out**; a timeout's message names the action and its limit, while a crash answers only `Internal server error`", matching the catalog row. The header comment of `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` no longer lists a sandbox timeout under crash.
- **Fix round 3 (contract review 6972256765, F1).** An action that declares `refusals` lost the timeout sentence: `boundActionHandler` hands every throw to `resolveActionRefusal`, and the catalogue read the sentence as the body's code-less throw, replaced it with the undeclared-refusal fault, answered the bare 500 on both doors and logged "threw no code" instead of the budget line. Measured before the fix on this branch's head `ddee9584b9`, through the real bound handler: both doors answered `Internal server error`. The compile-failure fault (`actionBodyCompileFailure`) had the same route, and the same mark covers it with no extra path.
  - `quickjs-runner.ts`: a module-level `runnerOwnFaults` WeakSet beside `hostRelayedErrors`. The runner marks the faults it makes itself that carry a caller sentence: the action arms of `budgetError` (CPU budget, wall-clock ceiling) and `actionBodyCompileFailure`. `isRunnerOwnFault` reads the mark. Identity, not a field: a body can throw `innerMessage` + `status: 500` + no code itself, so no field tells the two apart. The runner's other faults carry no `innerMessage` and pass as before.
  - `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`: `resolveSandboxedRefusal` passes a runner-own fault through before it reads any field. There is no pass-through on a declared server-band status: a body's own code-less throw with `status: 500`, even one spelled with the timeout's exact words, is still refused as undeclared. The module header says so.
  - `action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts` (the action-catalogue harness): a new top-level describe, through the real `actionBodyRunnerFactory` and read on the `/actions` door and `actionsDoorAnswerOf` (the reader MCP `run_action` renders). A CPU timeout and a wall-clock timeout each answer `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with the sentence on both doors, and the error logged at `error` still carries the runner's operator line, read at log time. A compile failure answers its sentence on both doors, and the log names the compiler. A control holds three code-less body throws (plain, `status: 500`, and `status: 500` with the timeout's own sentence) to the undeclared refusal and the bare 500 on both doors.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/runtime` patch. Round 3 adds one paragraph: the same holds for an action that declares `refusals`.

## Tests

<details><summary>Round 3 (head 48170d26e6): F1 red then green, ablation, package suite</summary>

- **Red before the fix.** The new describe, run against the unfixed runner and catalogue (`ddee9584b9` plus the test only): `Tests 3 failed | 17 passed (20)`. CPU timeout, received on both doors `"message": "Internal server error"` where the sentence was expected. Wall-clock timeout, the same. Compile failure: `expected 'Internal server error' to contain 'Action 'submit_signoff' cannot run:…'`. The control (code-less body throws stay refused) was green.
- **Green after the fix** (331f618981): `action-refusal-catalogue`, `sandboxed-action-crash-is-a-fault`, `hook-refusal-catalogue`, `unreadable-rejection-recorded`, `sandbox-unreadable-rejection-door`, `quickjs-runner`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 145 passed (145)`.
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: in `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`, replaced the line `if (isRunnerOwnFault(err)) return err;` with a comment. `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 1d140e65a29e -> 7bd11f4783b5`. The suite imports the catalogue from `src/` by relative path, so no dist rebuild was needed. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 17 passed (20)`; red: the CPU-timeout, wall-clock-timeout and compile-failure pins; the control stayed green. Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (1d140e65a29e) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (`--project local`): `Test Files 619 passed (619)`, `Tests 11500 passed | 23 skipped (11523)`, exit 0. The run was on the fix's code. The commit after it changes only the changeset.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- Core census `import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts` (`repo` project, run locally because it parses the edited runner): `Tests 48 passed (48)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Targeted files, package suites, typecheck (head d50f969537 for the re-runs after the last edit)</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run` (runtime) on `sandboxed-action-crash-is-a-fault`, `unreadable-rejection-recorded`, `sandbox-unreadable-rejection-door` and `quickjs-runner`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 87 passed (87)`.
- Re-run after the import fix (d50f969537), `sandbox-unreadable-rejection-door` and `sandboxed-action-crash-is-a-fault`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (`--project local`): `Test Files 618 passed (618)`, `Tests 11470 passed | 23 skipped (11493)`, exit 0. This ran on 1a88607c1e. The only change since then is a module-top side-effect import in one test file, and that file was re-run above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: `Test Files 71 passed (71)`, `Tests 1260 passed (1260)`, exit 0.
- `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: 180/180. `import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts` (core census, `repo` project, run locally because it parses the edited runner): 48/48.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). The first run was red on two untouched files, `TS2307 Cannot find module '@objectstack/driver-turso'`, because that dist had not been built. It went green once the dist was built. `@objectstack/mcp typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck: OK`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: three pins, each mutated once through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to blob == HEAD</summary>

The mutations are all in `quickjs-runner.ts`, which the suite imports from `src/` by relative path, so no dist rebuild was needed. `ablation-replace` reported each mutation as landed (anchor 1 -> 0). After each leg, the restore showed `git hash-object` = HEAD blob `bd7078824818` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- **(a) The timeout sentence, the same on both doors.** Replaced `actionTimeoutSentence(args.origin.name, cpuBudget, false),` with `undefined,`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`. Red: "the runner keeps its operator line, and declares 500 with the sentence and no code" and "the /actions door and the MCP run_action reader answer 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with the same sentence".
- **(b) A crash still sanitised.** Prefixed the crash relay's `innerMessage` with `'Action failed internally: '`, so it no longer reads as a native error. Result: `Tests 5 failed | 6 passed (11)`. Red: the new "control: a crash beside it keeps the sanitised 500 on both doors", plus the existing crash, runtime-SyntaxError and negative-control pins.
- **(c) A hook timeout unchanged on /data.** Widened the CPU arm's `args.origin.kind === 'action'` to `!== 'job'`, which pulls hooks into the action arm. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed (11)`. Red: "control: a hook timeout is unchanged, and the /data door answers it the sanitised fault".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold after round 3: the fix restores the ruled answer on a path the round-1 pins did not reach, and refuses nothing it accepted before.

- Round 2 fixed `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (the 500 bullet) and the `domains/actions.ts` header comment, after the claim amendment added both to the surface.
- The MCP pin (`mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`) drives `run_action` / `resume_run` with the runner's measured timeout shape. `@objectstack/mcp` does not depend on `@objectstack/runtime`, so the real-run half lives in the runtime file. That file feeds the same real error to the HTTP door and to `actionsDoorAnswerOf`, the reader the MCP tools render.
